page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a printed ornament between the closing line and the title. Signature at the foot.

main_text.p: μαστεω[?], quod exercitiorum beneficio acquisiuit, corpus agile & habile reddere, vt decenter obtemperentur membra & animi intentionem sequantur.

Χιὰ latibulum, φωλεός, ἢ τῶν ὄφεων κατάλυσις, serpentum lustrum, à verbo χίω[?], quod est χωρεῖ[?] capax sum, aut abscondo, quod inertes & laborum impatientes facere solent. Cleander ἐν χιᾷ non latuit: ergo fuit φιλόπονος: hinc ad victorias peruenit, ergo laudandus est.
main_text.head: IN PINDARVM.

page.notes: The Greek at the start of the first paragraph is cut off by the page edge and is uncertain. The Greek words in the second paragraph (Χιὰ, χίω, χωρεῖ) are only partly legible and are marked [?]. The ornament between the closing line and the title is not text and is omitted. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and is omitted.
